example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়ির ছেলেটি পুরো পরিবারের আহ্লাদের প্রহ্লাদ।
example_sentences_in_english: Her daughter is the apple of her eye.
The boy is the beloved child of the entire family.
history: This idiom is a playful reference to Prahlad, the devout son of the demon king Hiranyakashipu from Hindu mythology in the Puranas, symbolizing a child who brings immense joy and is deeply cherished.
note: The idiom twists 'Prahlad' (a religious figure) with 'ahlader' (of joy) to evoke endearment in everyday Bengali speech.
